name: @gjsify/gtk-quartz-native
description: Adds the missing Dock-click reopen handler to GTK's macOS application delegate, so a click on a windowless app's Dock icon activates the GApplication (ADR 0141). Contains no JavaScript; the prebuilt library and typelib arrive through per-target optionalDependencies.

osNotes.linux: Patches GtkApplicationQuartzDelegate, a class of GTK's macOS backend; GTK on Linux has no such class and desktops activate a running application through D-Bus.
osNotes.win32: Patches GtkApplicationQuartzDelegate, a class of GTK's macOS backend; GTK on Windows has no such class.

scripts.build:meson: gjsify run init:meson && meson compile -C build
scripts.test:meson: gjsify run build:meson && meson test -C build --print-errorlogs
